title: {{name}} and the New Planet
text:
{{name}} sat in a fast rocket. The rocket went up, up, up into space. It flew past the big white moon. Then {{name}} saw a new planet.

It was very little. No one ever saw it before. The rocket landed softly. {{name}} jumped out and looked around.

Wow! The planet was full of flowers. They were red, blue, pink, and yellow. The grass was soft and green. Small rocks were on the land. They started to shine. The little rocks were bright like stars.

{{name}} ran in the flowers. {{name}} jumped on soft, green hills. It was so much fun! {{name}} laughed and laughed.

Then {{name}} picked up a shining rock. It felt warm and smooth. {{name}} held it close and smiled.

"This is my planet," {{name}} said. "I found it. I will give it a name."

{{name}} looked at the bright flowers and happy hills. "I will call you Flower Star," {{name}} said softly.

The rocks were warm and bright. It was like a thank you. {{name}} felt full of joy.
